action_summary: Round 6 left 786 operations standing as RESOLVABLE_BY_DRIVING and zero as exhausted. Round 7 drove them and found the mass was not 786 unknowns but a handful of ASSUMPTIONS in the binder, each contradicting a line the program had already printed: argv[1] was assumed to be the flag; a usage line's own name and [options] were read as operands; `+int` was outside the spec regex so `-offset` declared nothing; a declared path flag was read as an artifact and never as an input; and the declared passphrase flags were not read at all. census() also parsed each subcommand's contract and then threw it away, binding children against the parent's flags. Every fix reads a declaration instead of adding a table.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Three routes were measured and rejected rather than argued. (1) Re-scan every time: that is what the tree did, and the ledger sat at 82 gaps with 0 resolved. (2) A learned ranker (KBD's RL policy over entropy): the same quantity is a count of verdicts decided, so a policy would cost parameters to measure what the census's rows already say. (3) A generalised value-slot rule: written, measured, cost cp a door, reverted, and pinned by a test.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 11 new tests, 59 across four suites. One receipt: 20 programs, SENSOR 880 -> 198 at an unchanged 33 doors, 5 kinds, 786 rescuable / 0 exhausted, doubt persisted to the ledger. No independent identity has re-run any of it.

benchmark_or_family_rank_authority: the census's own fleet measurement; no benchmark output is borrowed and no answer is leaked
capability_target: an unbound operation is bound from the DECLARATION that describes it -- flag by lookup, value type from the spec, value form from the description, input from the declared input flag, passphrase from the declared passphrase flag -- so the census converts unknown into doors by reading, not by acquiring knowledge
causal_blocker: the binder supplied an invocation the program did not ask for and omitted the half it did ask for, so an operation the program documents completely came back unbound
expected_parent_change: the census's unbound count falls by 110 on the 20-program fleet while its door count rises by 24, and the meaning of 'unknown' changes from 'we have not tried it' to 'the program asks for a precondition we have not built'
expected_parent_frontier_change: the frontier moves from binding defects to precondition construction: the dominant remaining openssl cluster is no longer a misread declaration
falsification_condition: if reading the declaration had not moved doors on programs whose help text was already parsed, the hypothesis that the unknown is a reading defect would be false; measured, doors moved 33 -> 57 with no program down, and the one program that documents itself most heavily moved 0 -> 24
highest_leverage_now: read the declaration for the SLOT ROLE (input/output), because `-in infile  input file` and `-out outfile  output file` are two lines of one help text and only the second was being read
honest_limits: the remaining 676 unbound operations on the 20-program fleet are 654 DROVE_IT_WRONG and 14 SLOT_UNSUPPLIED; openssl's largest remaining cluster is a real PRECONDITION (an offset into a DER stream, a certificate to verify against), which binding cannot supply

the composition that reads an input flag AND an output flag pays only with a type-matched seed: printable text moved nothing, a real DER certificate moved openssl 12 -> 14, so the standard trial understates it
four openssl subcommands create their output file before validating, so their litter is intrinsic and cannot become doors by any binding
_declared_passphrase writes a literal passphrase into a trial's own temporary tree; a fixture, never a credential, nothing persisted
authority is NONE and the run is sandbox-only; independent verification is OPEN
measured_effect: 15 programs, same script and seeds, BEFORE by checking out bbbe6af2's module on the same machine: DOOR 33 -> 57, FAILED_NO_EFFECT 759 -> 641, LITTER 1 -> 9 (all nine verified as refused requests that leave a file). openssl 0 -> 24 doors. ZERO programs went down. On the round-6 20-program fleet: DOOR 33 -> 57, UNBOUND 786 -> 676, SENSOR 568 -> 284.
next_step: separate PRECONDITION from BINDING in the failure taxonomy, because the binder is now reading what the program declared and the next mass is state that has to exist first
real_outcome: openssl went from a program with no doors to the largest single source of doors in the fleet, without one line of openssl-specific code, because its documentation had been read for years and its DECLARATIONS had not been read once

recursive_obs.stop_condition: A doubt recorded in one process is closed in another and the closing is credited from a real answer, re-run by an independent identity; until then the producer measurement stands alone.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: the declaration is already parsed by the time bind() runs, so the join costs a lookup; no probe, no fetch, no model call, and it holds for any program that documents itself

required_capability: a declaration reader, not a knowledge store: the help text is bounded, local, and the same on every machine that ships the program

route_order_walk.COMPOSE: SELECTED: carrier()'s description-reading mechanism is reused for the input and passphrase roles; _placeholder_in and the new scope fields are lookups, not tables.
route_order_walk.ADAPT: The scope a subcommand declares is carried on its own rows, so any program with subcommands adapts without a name list.
route_order_walk.BYPASS: Not used. Bypassing the declaration is what produced 786 fake unknowns.
route_order_walk.INVENT: Not used. No new inference: every value comes from a line the program printed.

selectivity_note: the control that keeps this honest is the REVERSE order: a two-step answer that both orders satisfied would not be a sequence at all
stop_condition: stop when every operation whose declaration was parsed also binds to the command that declaration describes, and the remaining failures are preconditions rather than misreadings
